scenarios.name: Require actual upload acceptance
scenarios.given: an archive export succeeded without upload acceptance
scenarios.when: the TestFlight helper evaluates its result

scenarios.name: Do not upload the same build twice
scenarios.when: the helper is called again for that build
scenarios.then: the accepted receipt prevents another upload

scenarios.name: Keep unreleased Watch out of the beta
scenarios.given: the Watch physical-device release gate is still open
scenarios.when: a candidate embeds a Watch app

scenarios.name: Identify the feedback beta and bundled changes accurately
scenarios.given: a user updates to the iPad compatibility feedback beta
scenarios.when: What’s New appears or is reopened
scenarios.then: the app identifies version 1.17.1 build 35 with its device-compatible recording and explicit AI setup notes, acknowledges the update once and keeps prior notes readable
